mods.name: Player Utils
mods.description:
Player Utils is a comprehensive utility mod that adds four powerful commands for server administration and gameplay enhancement:

・/choke – Forces players to suffocate (air depletes rapidly) unless specific inventory conditions are met. When conditions are satisfied, oxygen restores. Without conditions (slotList omitted), the effect is unconditional and always active. Once air reaches zero, the player takes drowning damage every 5 ticks (3 damage per hit).

・/health – Locks a player's health to a specified value (1–100) until inventory conditions are met. When conditions are satisfied, health control is released and natural regeneration resumes. Without conditions, health is permanently locked to the set value.

・/pvp – Disables a player's ability to attack other players. The affected player will be unable to deal any damage to players and will receive a chat warning when attempting to attack. Use /pvp stop to re-enable attacking.

・/autosp (auto spawnpoint) – Records the player's death position. When the player dies and clicks the respawn button, they will respawn exactly at the death location instead of the world spawn point. Works only if enabled before death.

All commands support targeting players (@a, @p, @r, or usernames) and stop subcommands can be used without arguments to affect the command sender. All states are persisted in the player's NBT data, surviving server restarts and relogs.

Optional inventory conditions (slotList) can be specified for /choke and /health using a JSON format (e.g., [{"hotbar.8":{"minecraft:bedrock"}}]), enabling complex gameplay mechanics based on the player's carried items.

Permission level: 2 (OP) required for all commands.

releases.notes:
# Player Utils

A NeoForge mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that adds utility commands for server administration.

## Features

- `/choke` – Force players to suffocate unless inventory conditions are met.
- `/health` – Lock a player's health to a fixed value.
- `/pvp` – Disable a player's ability to attack other players.
- `/autosp` – Respawn at death location when clicking respawn button.

All states are persisted across server restarts and relogs.

## Requirements

- NeoForge 21.1.235 or later
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Java 21 (or 17)
